satow-tasj-vol9:
Volume Nine of the Transactions covers 1880 and 1881, printed in 1881. Satow, Aston, and Chamberlain lead the circle of reporting pioneers. The Ancient Japanese Rituals series continues its run in this volume.

Papers probe old Japan's history, tongue, and customs with growing skill. The team works from texts, tombs, temples, and tales across the land. Each report lays one more stone in the field's firm base. The yearly rhythm gives the set the feel of a shared diary. Western Japanology comes of age across these modest, packed volumes of reports. The rituals series alone would earn this volume its lasting place.
